## Release/Security Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, local databases, generated runtime data, or private paths are committed.
- [ ] Dependency changes update the matching lockfile and pass the lock verifier.
- [ ] Packaging/signing changes update release evidence or document the remaining waiver.
- [ ] User-facing behavior or API changes update docs/tests where applicable.
